international.title: Alan Jones defence opens and closes in space of a few hours as indecent assault trial draws to a close
international.summary: Former broadcaster, 85, has pleaded not guilty to 21 counts of sexual touching and indecent assault Alan Jones’s defence in his indecent assault and sexual touching trial has lasted only a few hours, with closing submissions in the long-running case due next week. Jones’s barrister Gabrielle Bashir SC opened the defence case on Friday by stating “I am not calling the defendant”, ending months of speculation about whether the former broadcaster, 85, would give evidence.
